subject: general
question: As of 10 April 2022, who among the following is serving as the Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bhupesh Baghel.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhupesh Baghel assumed the office of Chief Minister of the station on **17 December 2018 **and succeeded Raman Singh.
 
• He belongs to Indian National Congress and Patan Assembly constituency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Chhattisgarh:__

 __
 
• The state came into existence on November 1, 2000, after its separation from Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The capital of Chhattisgarh is Raipur.
 
• The state ranks 9th in terms of area and 16th in terms of population.
 
• State animal: Wild Water Buffalo.
 
• State bird: Common Hill Myna.
